text_block_list.text:
Summer camp with Бива Хаяхидэ
commences.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Уиннинг Тикит and Нарита Таисин are
here too,
and they run into us right as
we're unloading our
luggage.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
All three of them are fired up about the
Kikuka
Sho, so it's time to let the
summer of friendly
rivalry begin!
text_block_list.name: Монолог
